We have the case: user wants to exchange garden hose from delivered order #W7181492 for a hose in pending order #W2575533. The policy says exchange only within a delivered order, cannot exchange across orders. The assistant explained that and offered to look at pending order details. The user insists that the hose in pending order is not the one they need, and asks to look again. The assistant responded: "I understand your concern, and I really very carefully studied the details of your order #W2575533. According to system data, in this order there is only one garden hose item — the black vinyl hose 50ft ID 5206946487. No other hoses in this order. If you are sure you ordered something else, and data in system is displayed incorrectly, I cannot fix this myself with available tools. In this situation best solution is to transfer you to a human agent who can check order history and figure out why system shows wrong item. Do you want me to transfer you to an operator?"

We need to see if any error: The assistant says they "really very carefully studied the details" and that according to system data there is only one garden hose. That matches the earlier get_order_details for #W2575533 which shows items list includes a Garden Hose with ID 5206946487. No other hose. So that's correct.
